summary: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (National Steel Co; B3: CSNA3, NYSE: SID) filed a 6-K announcing a 10-day exclusivity agreement with Huaxin Building Materials Group to negotiate definitive documents for the sale of shares in subsidiary CSN Cimentos Brasil S.A. The agreement contemplates an enterprise value of R$12.7 billion, with signing expected within days; Huaxin submitted the most advantageous proposal in the competitive process launched in March 2026. No share price or premium was disclosed, and no board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch definitive-document execution, regulatory approvals in Brazil, and proceeds allocation/leverage reduction as the risk-arb angle.
